::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 81,704 people lived in County Cavan, up 7.3% on 2016. It had the 20th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 34% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Cavan was €1,095, the 21st highest of the 26 counties.
:::
